sentences.text: At seven hundred you depart from a charted buoy, and the first question asks for its latitude and longitude, which you read from the scales.
Next, lay a course to the next mark and read zero six eight true from the rose.
The question gives variation fifteen west and deviation two east, so the compass course is zero six eight plus fifteen minus two: zero eight one.
The leg measures nine point six miles; at twelve knots, that’s forty-eight minutes, for an ETA of seven forty-eight.
